findings.claim: The server-surface recommendation omits one of the three homes the assessment explicitly required analyze to consider: extending openai-proxy.
findings.evidence: Prior handoff open question: "Where does the server surface live? Extending openai-proxy is out-of-repo; scaffold-react-vite-axum.sh (431 lines) is the closest existing home; a Node dev-server route is a third option." Analysis says, "The assessment offered three homes. Evidence narrows it to one," but then evaluates only "Rust/Axum — reject" and "Node — recommend"; there is no verdict or rationale for extending openai-proxy.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit openai-proxy candidate evaluation with a verdict, including whether out-of-repo status makes it impossible, deferred, or still required by the phase definition.
